check: verify the walking and client-visual entries, in particular the claim that the visual observer must be human
why: These two entries will be read by a person deciding what to do next, and the visual one makes a strong claim: that automation cannot substitute. If that claim were overstated, the entry would be asking for work that is not actually required.

theClaimIsEnforcedRatherThanDocumented.rule1: The observer field must be either human or automated_state; anything else throws IllegalArgumentException.
theClaimIsEnforcedRatherThanDocumented.rule2: When the observer is automated_state, either visible or merged being true throws, with the message that state evidence cannot attest visibility or smoke merging.
theClaimIsEnforcedRatherThanDocumented.rule3: Merged smoke must also be visible, so the two cannot be asserted independently.
theClaimIsEnforcedRatherThanDocumented.verdict: The schema refuses an automated claim of visibility rather than merely discouraging it. That makes the entry's why precise rather than rhetorical.

supportInTheTests.line27: SmokeVisualChecklistTests prints human_visibility=NOT_RUN human_smoke_merging=NOT_RUN, which is the test stating its own unrun status.
supportInTheTests.line135: A case named humanAndStateEvidenceStayDistinct constructs one state observation and one human observation and asserts both are retained separately.
supportInTheTests.line146: The assertion reads that observer evidence must remain explicit, so a human observation cannot be folded into a state one.

theWalkingEntryIsSoundButDependsOnTheSam.claim: Programmatic traversal of 505 owners cannot substitute for a person walking it.
theWalkingEntryIsSoundButDependsOnTheSam.consistency: The traversal certificate records owners, voxels and walkway feet - counts, not judgements. Nothing in it assesses whether the wall looks or feels right, so the entry is right that it cannot substitute.
theWalkingEntryIsSoundButDependsOnTheSam.howItIsReached: It names the runWallPreview path or an opened production path, which is the same route the visual entry gives.
